candidate.description: PROC-500 Talent Flow — mapping of 28 defined elements (02-define.json) to the 24-layer target structure from the US-derived invariant set. The target structure is the Unified Template expressed as layers L1-L24. Each source element maps to a target layer position. Elements E25-E28 are cross-cutting findings that do not map to a single target layer — they are documented as unmapped with explicit reasons.
candidate.scope: Source: 28 elements from 02-define.json. Target: 24 layers from us-handoff.json invariant set. Run 1 — propose only, no lock.
candidate.target_structure: Unified Template — 24 layers across 3 clusters (Identity L2/Contract L3/Governance L4) rooted at L1, with depth-2 leaves (L5-L18) and depth-3 leaves (L19-L24). Each layer has a fixed schema declared in the US handoff.

mappings.reason: PROCESS.md exists at declared CTB position with all 3 cluster headers. Direct structural match to L1 root medium.
Sections 1-2 plus section 4/8 cover all 3 children (L5, L6, L7). Cluster container maps directly.
Sections 3-6 cover 4 of 5 children (L8, L9, L11, L12). L10 (DMJ) structurally absent in required format. Cluster exists but is incomplete — one child gap.
Sections 7-13 cover 5 of 6 children (L13, L14, L16, L17, L18). L15 (execution trace) schema not declared. Cluster exists but is incomplete — one child gap.

18/18 fields present across process table and heir.yaml. Direct structural match. Classified as transformed because heir.yaml field VALUES contradict PROCESS.md (runtime, snap_on_tools, ut_sub_hubs) — the structure maps but values require correction. The format is correct; the fill is wrong.
Prose block names downstream dependency (Process 100) and what breaks without this process (outreaching to ghosts). Structural constraint satisfied exactly.
All 4 sub-tables present: dependencies (3 rows), downstream consumers (1 row), tools (2 items), secrets (1 secret). Direct match to L7 four-table schema.
All 5 sub-components present: Two-Question Intake (both answered), Input (prose), Middle table (4 rows, 5 columns), Output (names Process 100), Circle (90-day expiry). Direct match.
All 4 sub-sections present: READ table (4 rows), WRITE implied (signal_output), join chain to outreach_id spine, forbidden paths (5 items). Grid Reader compatible — output joins to outreach_id.

Section 6 has C&V content with mathematical definitions but NOT in the DMJ three-step format. L19 (Define table, 5 cols), L20 (Map table, 3 cols), L21 (Join table, 3 cols) are all absent. The forced Define->Map->Join order is not implemented. Largest structural gap. Cannot be mapped — must be built.
Section 6 has both lists: constants (with comparator, primitive, k_i) and variables (6 items). Mathematical block (P(x;theta), r(x), stability) exceeds minimum requirements. Direct match.

7 stop conditions declared, threshold of 6 met. Format matches (Condition, Action table). Classified as transformed because canonical coverage has 1-2 gaps: no explicit '5 consecutive errors' condition, no 'budget cap' condition. Total count passes but canonical set is not fully enumerated.
5 numbered steps with expected results. Three Primitives Check present with all 3 questions (Thing, Flow, Change). All sub-comparators pass. Direct match.

3 sub-sections present but L24 (ORBT gate rules) is incomplete — only sigma direction rules + Strike 3, not all 4 explicit ORBT transitions. Metrics table uses 'Type' instead of 'Unit', lacks explicit 'Tolerance' column. Structure present, format deviations require transformation.

Section 11 contains only 'No runs logged yet.' The 14-field per-step entry schema is NOT declared. No schema = no mapping possible. Source code writes to stdout only. Must be built — schema declaration required before any execution can emit trace entries.
Correctly absent — process is BUILD state. No logbook until BUILD->OPERATE auditor sign-off. Absence IS the correct mapping for this ORBT state.

Section 12 has 8 known issues at strike 0 with 6-column table. Target requires 7-column Failure Pattern Registry (Pattern ID, Location, Error Code, First Seen, Occurrences, Strike Count, Status). Close but column count differs — needs 1 additional column.

Section 13 has 1 entry with 3 columns (Date, What Was Done, Knowledge Record ID). Column 3 labeled 'imo-brain Document' instead of 'Knowledge Record ID' — terminology needs alignment to LBB reference. Structure matches, label is stale.

DMJ Step 1 absent. Section 6 has C&V output but NOT in the 5-column Define table (Element, ID, Format, Description, C-or-V). Mathematical comparator table partially overlaps but uses different schema. Must be built from scratch using the C&V content as input.
DMJ Step 2 absent. No Source->Target->Transform table exists. Cannot execute without L19 (forced dependency). Must be built after L19 is resolved.

DMJ Step 3 absent as formal format. However, OSAM join chain in section 5 (person_id -> unique_id -> person_unique_id -> outreach_id) provides functionally equivalent join path data. The content EXISTS but not in the L21 format (Join Path, Type, Description). Could be transformed from OSAM data into L21 format rather than built from scratch.

Section 10 has 6 metrics with baselines. Target schema: 5 columns (Metric, Unit, Baseline, Target, Tolerance). Source uses 'Type' instead of 'Unit' and lacks explicit 'Tolerance' column. Column rename + addition required.

Section 10 has sigma tracking table with 5 columns (Run Date, Metric, Value, Sigma Direction, Notes). Target schema: 6 columns (Metric, Run 1, Run 2, Run 3+, Trend, Action). Different schema layout — run-per-column vs run-per-row. Structural transformation required, not just rename.

Partial coverage only. Has sigma direction->action mappings and Strike 3 rule. Missing: explicit enumeration of all 4 state transitions (BUILD->OPERATE, OPERATE->REPAIR, REPAIR->OPERATE, Any->TROUBLESHOOT_TRAIN) with gate conditions. Missing: auditor != builder enforcement for certification gates. Must be rebuilt to full L24 spec.

Cross-document inconsistency. heir.yaml declares runtime=cloudflare-workers, snap_on_tools=[LinkedInCheck, ScraperAPI], ut_sub_hubs=[fetcher, proxy-router, cache-layer]. PROCESS.md says Python 3, no external APIs, pure DB diff. No single target layer — this is a data quality issue spanning L5 (identity). Requires heir.yaml field value correction, not structural mapping.

Code quality finding — f-string SQL interpolation in talent-flow.py. Not a structural template layer. No target in the 24-layer invariant set. Belongs in L17 (Fleet Learning) as a known issue entry, not as a structural mapping. Documented, not mapped.
Security finding — cleartext DATABASE_URL fallback. Not a structural template layer. Already logged as Known Issue #3. Belongs in L17 as a fleet learning entry. Documented, not mapped.

PROCESS.md uses 13 sections; Unified Template specifies 14. Section numbering diverges at section 3 (process) vs section 4 (template). Affects L1 (root medium format: '14 numbered sections matching Unified Template'). This is a structural deviation at L1 that automated parsers will hit. Cannot be resolved by mapping alone — requires PROCESS.md section renumbering.

unmapped_element_count.measurement: Count of source elements (E01-E28) with target=null. These are defined elements that do not correspond to any single layer in the 24-layer target structure. 4 elements unmapped: E25 (heir inconsistency), E26 (SQL injection), E27 (hardcoded creds), E28 (section numbering).

unresolved_mapping_count.measurement: Count of mappings with type='unresolved' (including both null-target and has-target-but-unresolvable). These represent elements that cannot be connected to the target structure without new construction. 8 total: E10, E15, E19, E20, E24 (structural gaps requiring build), E25, E26, E27 (cross-cutting findings with no target layer).

format_deviation_count.measurement: Count of mappings with type='transformed'. These are elements where source data exists but format does not match target schema — requires column renames, additions, or structural reshaping. 6 total: E05 (heir value mismatch), E12 (canonical gap), E14 (ORBT incomplete), E17 (column count), E18 (label stale), E22 (column rename), E23 (schema reshape).

target_layer_gap_count.measurement: Count of target layers (L1-L24) that have NO direct or transformed mapping — only unresolved or absent. Layers with unresolved mappings: L10 (DMJ), L15 (execution trace), L19 (define step), L20 (map step), L24 (ORBT gate rules). 5 target layers cannot be satisfied from existing source material.

inferred_mapping_count.measurement: Count of mappings with type='inferred'. These are mappings deduced from partial or functionally equivalent content that exists in a different format. 1 total: E21 (join step — OSAM data exists but not in L21 format). Inferred mappings carry higher risk than direct or transformed.
